evidence: In2O3 and ITO films were grown from InCl3, SnCl4, and H2O2H2O (30:70) solution using a flow type ALE reactor1 and the growth parameters optimized earlier for the InCl3-H2O5 and InCl3-SnCl4H2O6 processes. The only difference being that 30% H2O2, rather than water, was used as an oxygen source.
